$comment: Canonical placeholder registry: one concept, one name. bootstrap/fix-placeholders.mjs applies aliases to catalog/ and bootstrap/merge-catalog.mjs validates catalog metadata. Legacy keys are retained for compatibility.

canonicos.ENGINE: Main engine or stack (Godot 4, Unreal 5, Expo/React Native, TanStack Start).
canonicos.CHECK_COMMAND: The command that proves readiness. Keep one here; additional commands belong in scopes.json check_runners.
canonicos.HEADLESS_CMD: Game verification without a UI: the command that runs the scene/test and exits.
canonicos.CANON_PATHS: Binding project sources (product bible, brief, canon, product documentation). Changes require a decision.
canonicos.DECISION_LOG: Dated record of existing decisions. Reopening a decision requires a new human decision.
canonicos.RESEARCH_DIR: Market research and reference material directory.
canonicos.EVIDENCE_DIR: Screenshots, logs, and verification evidence directory.
canonicos.DB: Database and mode (Postgres+RLS via Supabase, local SQLite, none).
canonicos.GENERATED_FILES: Generated files that must not be edited manually; listed in global_deny.
canonicos.MONEY_PATHS: Paths that handle money. Each requires one owner and mandatory review.
canonicos.GAMEPLAY_PATHS: Code determining game outcomes (rules, physics, AI, save), separate from presentation.
canonicos.RISK_CLASS: Project risk classes and their gates. Name classes from real invariants.
canonicos.OWNERS: Agent-to-path map. scopes.json is authoritative; this is its readable summary.
canonicos.QA_AGENT: Role that runs the test suite and reports defects without fixing them.
canonicos.DELEGATABLE_AGENTS: Comma-separated list of agent IDs the lead may spawn via Agent(...) — derived from the project's actual installed team, never a static default. Computed by new-project.mjs at bootstrap time, not filled from placeholder-defaults.json.
canonicos.REPORT_LANGUAGE: Language of reports to the user. Default: en; customize when requested.
canonicos.ENGINE_CRAFT_SKILL: Skill containing verified engine/stack APIs (godot-craft, unreal-ops, unity-craft). Starts empty and grows with executed evidence.
canonicos.TOKENS_DIR: Design token file/directory. Only design-steward writes it.
canonicos.UE_ROOT: Unreal project root: directory containing the .uproject, which may differ from the repository root.
canonicos.ENGINE_DIR: Engine installation path on this machine. Machine-local; never committed.

resolvidos.$comment: Placeholders that refer to known catalog skills or roles become literal names, avoiding unnecessary interview questions.
